What a game.  Exciting.  Two generally equal teams.  Neither backed down.
Miami turned up the heat in the final 2-3 minutes.  Really should have scored on multiple shots.  This will absolutely give Atlanta some belief.  They put in a shift and came away with a point when they shouldn't have.  The goals given up will not have dampened their spirits.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - quiet for most of the game.  Came up big with point black shots in the final maylay at the end
Báez - a few miss plays.  His attacking ball movement was good.  His distribution getting better
Alonso - Got better as the game went on.  Final block saved the game.  He was on a high after the match
Jacob - I can think of good plays throughout, and yet, didn't do enough.  He was often caught out.  He struggled to contain the Miami players on his side
Reilly - He's running out of time to be replaced.  The game is too fast for him.  He did enough but it was right to sub him.
Sanchez - Was outmatched in midfield.  It looked like the concussion ultimately took him out.  Prior to that, he was struggling to keep control in midfield.  Wasn't able to do much offensively
Almirón - a very good night, again.  Looks like he's found a good target with Embolo to work off of.  He did a lot of work on the left, in midfield, and plays well with midfield.  Looks like he's starting to change his play, to play less on sprinting runs, and more with distribution.  His pen was not a good one, and he needed to put that away.
Muyumba - Good, not great game.  not much to complaign about.  But was outmatched.  He was able to recover some fantastic balls he didn't have a right to.  
Miranchuk - a quiet first half.  He came alive after the 60th.  Suddenly able to distribute well.  Some great passing and runs.  We'll remember the final 30, but he should have played like that in the first 60.  
Embolo - a fantastic debut.  played deep to get the ball, but it was never what he relied on.  He played interacting with his teammates.  His head was on a swivvel.  He moved around, a lot.  Looks to have raised the play of the players around him.  He could be a phenominal signing for Atlanta.

subs - 
Amaro - I really liked what he was able to do.  Was having to defend a lot, but still had an eye for moving the ball forward.  Got the ball clear and away from Miami, then passed to open players.  Excited to see a full start
Alzate - Best game in quite a while.  He outperformed both Reilly and Sanchez.  With Sanchez down with concussion, I would play Alzate in the next game
Edwards - I really enjoyed what he did tonight.  Was asked to play more attacking, and it looked more natural than when he previously tried it.  He played better than Jacob on that side
a84 - very nice plays to come back and strip balls off Miami in dangerous spots, and some sweet plays into the box.  

Tata - made subs to change the game early.  He changed out the midfield when they weren't able to control it any longer.  Also recognized that Jacob was struggling.  Later brought on Picault.  All subs he made improved the play of the collective whole
